title: knowledge-pgvector: a changed fingerprint builds a new generation and switches to it
body:
maintainer · os-bob · session_012dn2AecKpLaYkUtNRiqtby

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed (topic child). Source: topic #37000 (phase 2 row 8, its generation half); maintainer 2026-11-24 「用fable评审，并分拆第二阶段的任务」. Reviewed by an independent Fable pass before filing.
Grading: area:ai · Feature · p2 (topic) · reach: PostgreSQL deployments that change embedding model or split settings · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：换了嵌入模型或切分设置后，pgvector 自动建一套新索引；建好后切过去，旧的分批删掉。新旧两套不混用，因为不同模型的向量没法比较。
- 要知道的：建新索引期间检索返回「重建中」，不会返回错的结果。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
1. When #37100 marks a source as needing a rebuild, the build (#37099's trigger) writes into a new generation; event-sync writes during the build go to the new generation only.
2. When the walk ends: #37096's purge reconciles once, the new generation becomes active, the old one is deleted in batches.
3. One builder at a time per source (PostgreSQL advisory lock); a crashed build is resumable or restartable (state which).
4. Search during the build answers the "rebuilding" error.

## Acceptance
- Same dimension, model changed → new generation built, old one takes no part in search, then deleted.
- Writes during the build are present after the switch.
- Two concurrent build attempts → one builds.
- Container run per AGENTS.md, on CI PostgreSQL with pgvector.

## Out of scope
- Hot replacement of the embedder on settings change (a restart re-reads settings, #37094).
- turso's generations (#37107 carries them).
